user.title: Connect Registros Cámaras
user.description: Create an integration key in the application's Home Assistant page. This is a client of that application's API.

data_description.url: The application origin, including http:// or https:// and its port, without /api or a page path. It must be reachable from Home Assistant.
data_description.api_key: The rc_ key issued by this application, not a Home Assistant access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace integration key
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new key in the application using the same account.

data_description.api_key: The new rc_ key issued by this application.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Connect to the same application account using a new address or key.

data_description.url: Application origin reachable from Home Assistant, without a page path.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the existing key.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS origin without a path, query or embedded credentials.
error.invalid_auth: The integration key is invalid, revoked or unauthorized.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the application. Check its address, certificate and network access from Home Assistant.
error.incompatible_api: This server does not support the required Registros Cámaras API.

abort.already_configured: This application account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The connection belongs to a different application account.

init.title: Pending change notifications
init.description: Choose a mobile_app notification service for actionable notifications, or a notification in Home Assistant. The application API validates every confirmation.
